billing_method.description: How it is billed (FR-PRJ-10): time and materials, fixed fee by milestone, retainer drawn down, or internal (never billed).

budget_amount.description: The money budget in the project's currency, a decimal string.

budget_minutes.description: The hours budget in whole minutes (400 hours is 24000).

code.description: Its code, unique among the projects and never changed.

configured.description: false for a value of the Project dimension that has no project record yet (it was added through the dimensions): send replaceProject with If-Match "0" to set it up.

currency.description: The currency it is billed in (FR-PRJ-06); it never changes.

ends_on.description: The last day of the work.

id.description: The project's ID: the ID of its value in the Project dimension, which lines carry as a dimension value (FR-DIM-02).

people.description: The members, managers first; a member logs time, a manager also approves it.

starts_on.description: The first day of the work.

status.description: Where the project is. A closed project takes no new time and its dimension value goes out of use.

version.description: The project record's version, for If-Match; 0 when it is not configured.

warnings.description: What deserves a look, such as a manager who holds no role that approves time.

items.description: What deserves a look, in plain words, such as a manager who holds no role that approves time.
examples: Sam Tan is named a manager but holds no role that approves time (the Approver or the Controller): they cannot approve until they are given one
